QuestInfo.name: Hersha's Paranoia 1
QuestInfo.0: #p1103003# was once a Cygnus Knight, but left to investigate #m101000000#. He has a reputation for being VERY suspicious of everything. That being said, he claims to have found something...suspicious. You might want to check it out, just in case.
QuestInfo.1: #p1103003# found a #t4000029#, and is convinced it is a bomb disguised as a banana, so he wants you to bring him #b20#k #b#t4000029#s#k from #r#o3210800#s#k. This may be one of the dumbest requests you've ever gotten, but what's the harm in humoring him? #r#o3210800#s#k usually appear around #b#m101040000##k.
QuestInfo.2: #p1103003# discovered the bananas were not, in fact, bombs. Shocking. However, he is still suspicious of Lupin's Bananas.
QuestInfo.rewardSummary: EXP 1,500 #Wbasic# #i2040707:# #t2040707:# x 1 Can proceed to the Hersha's Paranoia 2 quest

0.0: Aaahh! It's you! You're a spy sent by the Black Wings, aren't you? No? Perhaps I can trust you. There's a huge conspiracy going on, RIGHT HERE in #m101000000#! It's up to us to save everyone. Can you help me, not-spy?

yes.0: You know the #r#o3210800#s#k, in the #b#m101040000##k? I've been watching them...and I think their bananas are really bombs! No, it's true! I saw one explode when it landed on a stray land mine! Don't you see? If the #r#o3210800#s#k throw their bananas at the same time, the resulting explosion will destroy all of #m101000000#...no, all of Maple World!! You MUST bring me #b20 #t4000029#s#k. Quickly!

no.0: You don't want to protect #m101000000#? Ah HA! I knew it! You ARE a spy for the Black Wings! I'm calling in backup right now to bring you in! You just wait there. No moving!

1.0: Where are the bananas? Bring them to me! We have to get them away from the Lupins! Only I can be trusted, so bring them to me!

yes.0: Welp, I guess these are regular bananas. *Munch munch* Still, we must be on our guard. *Munch munch* It's possible they saw you coming, and switched all the exploding bananas *munch munch* with tasty bananas.
yes.1: Anyway, good work today! The town is safe, I got some bananas, and you got...well, you got nothing. Er, here, have a scroll.

item.0: Yes, I need you to bring me #b20 #t4000029#s#k! Only I can be trusted to defuse these terrible bombs! Hurry, before #m101000000# is destroyed! Get to the #b#m101040000##k!
